group.expand: Show the submissions in this group
group.collapse: Hide the submissions in this group

empty.title: All reviewed
empty.body: Nothing in your groups is waiting for an answer. New work appears here the moment it is handed in.
empty.filteredBody: Clear them to see the rest of the queue.

inbox.failed: The queue could not be loaded.
inbox.selectBody: Choose one on the left and it opens here.

overdueBy.hours: {n, plural, one {# hour past} other {# hours past}}
overdueBy.days: {n, plural, one {# day past} other {# days past}}

age.spread: {n, plural, one {# submission} other {# submissions}}, oldest {oldest}

failed.title: This submission could not be opened
failed.body: It may have been decided, or the connection dropped. Try again from the queue.

conflict.title: {name} has just reviewed this
conflict.approved: Passed at {time}. Your draft is kept below.
conflict.returned: Returned for revision at {time}. Your draft is kept below.

windowExpired.title: You can no longer decide this one
windowExpired.body: Your assignment to this group ended after the work was handed in. You can read it; the verdict belongs to whoever teaches the group now.

lockExpired.title: Your marker on this submission ran out
lockExpired.body: The fifteen minutes are up. Nobody else has taken it — carry on, and it will be marked for you again as you work.

heldBy.title: {name} is looking at this one
heldBy.body: You are not blocked. It frees up in about fifteen minutes, and whoever decides first is the one who answers.

exerciseGone.title: The exercise is no longer there
exerciseGone.body: Its author deleted or moved it after this was handed in. The path above is the one the learner saw, and the verdict is still yours to give.

noDetails.title: The breakdown could not be built
noDetails.body: The answer is shown as it was handed in. Read it and decide as usual — the machine simply had nothing to compare it against.

previous.title: Returned for revision
previous.explain: This is a separate try. The answer below is the new one.

submission.closedVerbatim: {closed} of {total} closed by the machine, word for word
submission.essay: The work · {words, plural, one {# word} other {# words}}

comment.sentencePlaceholder: What should the learner look at here?

rubric.facts: {words, plural, one {# word} other {# words}} · {paragraphs, plural, one {# paragraph} other {# paragraphs}} · {hit}/{needed} points phrased
rubric.tickedNotHit: The learner ticked this off but none of its keywords appear. They may have phrased it another way — read the text.
rubric.remaining: {count, plural, one {# criterion left} other {# criteria left}}
rubric.incomplete: Mark every criterion before deciding — a blank one is not a zero.

decision.commentPlaceholder: A comment on the work as a whole. Write it in Norwegian — the æøå pad is below. Your draft is kept as you type.
decision.returnRequiresComment: Say what should be changed — the work goes back to the learner together with your comment.
decision.failed: The verdict could not be recorded. Try again.
decision.scoreIsServerSide: Sending back needs a comment: the learner gets the work together with it. The score is worked out by the system from what was passed — no mark is entered by hand.
decision.scoreIsRubric: The verdict follows from the rubric: a total at or above the pass mark is a pass, below it goes back. The score is worked out by the system from the marks — no percentage is entered by hand.

dialog.title: Pass {count} submissions the machine closed?
dialog.body: These learners answered «{exercise}» exactly as the answer key has it, and nothing was left for a person to read.
dialog.irreversible: There is no undo. Each learner is told their work was passed, and the verdict is recorded in your name.

batch.done: {count, plural, one {# submission passed} other {# submissions passed}}

skipped.not_clean: {count} needs reading after all — the answer key has changed

batch.failed: Nothing was passed — the batch could not be sent.

oversight.title: Review
oversight.subtitle: Where work has piled up, and who could use a hand. A delay here is a sign of load.

period.label: Period the replies are counted over

summary.title: The school

summary.sinceUnknown: Nothing has been handed in for review yet.
summary.medianNone: nothing was answered in this period
summary.truncated: The school has more waiting than this screen counts. The shape is right; the totals stop at the ceiling.

oversight.failed: The load could not be read.

teachers.sub: Who is under pressure shows in the length of the tail, not in one number.
teachers.empty: Nothing is waiting on anyone right now.
teachers.reminded: Reminded {name} — {n, plural, one {# submission} other {# submissions}} waiting
teachers.remindedAlready: Already reminded today. The next one can go in about {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}.
teachers.remindFailed: The reminder could not be sent.

courses.title: Courses
courses.sub: A course may promise a different response time

stuck.title: Not moving
stuck.sub: {n, plural, one {# submission has} other {# submissions have}} been waiting longer than promised
stuck.emptySub: nothing is past its promised time
stuck.empty: Everything waiting is still inside the time the school promised.
stuck.noReviewer: learner is in no group — there is no reviewer

journal.title: Decision journal
journal.sub: Over {n} days · who, when, and what came of it
journal.empty: Nobody has answered anything in this period.
journal.failed: The journal could not be read.

assign.title: Add a reviewer

banner.title: This adds the person to the group's staff
banner.body: There is no separate «reviewer» role: whoever teaches the learner's group may answer their work. The person you add sees this group's whole queue in their inbox straight away.

noGroup.title: This learner is in no group
noGroup.body: Nobody can be made responsible for this work until the learner belongs to a group — the rule runs through the group, not through the submission. Add them to one from the learners page, and their work joins that group's queue.

assign.failed: The reviewer could not be added.
assign.assigned: Added — the group's queue is now theirs as well.

settings.title: Response times
settings.lede: One number sets the whole urgency scale: the colour of the queue, what counts as stuck in oversight, and the date a learner is given while they wait.
settings.sub: The promise everything else is measured against

respond.label: Answer within
respond.hint: Work older than this is coloured as waiting too long.

escalate.label: Escalate after
escalate.hint: When to tell someone else that there is still no answer.
escalate.beforeRespond: Escalation cannot come before the promise itself.

escalateTo.label: Escalate to
escalateTo.hint: Receives a summary of what is stuck, not a letter per submission.

settings.preview: This is how the age scale reads at {n} h.
settings.saveFailed: The response time could not be saved.
settings.failed: The response time could not be read.
settings.readOnly: Only the owner and administrators can change this.

course.title: Response time
course.lede: How long this course promises a learner will wait for a verdict.
course.ownTime: Its own response time for this course
course.inheritedIs: Inherited value — {n} h. Clear the box to go back to it.
course.noSchoolPromise: The school has not set a response time yet.
course.saveFailed: The response time could not be saved.
course.failed: The response time could not be read.

student.subtitlePartial: Counted over what is loaded so far — scroll on for the rest.

due.unknown: No response time set for this course
due.note: That is the usual time this school takes, not a promise for the minute.

pending.body: Handed in {age} ago, waiting in your teacher's queue.

approved.noComment: Marked as correct, with nothing to add.

returned.hint: Another go is a new attempt — this comment stays here beside it.
returned.superseded: You have already had another go at this one — the newest attempt is the one that counts.

group.count: {count, plural, one {# exercise} other {# exercises}} handed in

empty.title: Nothing handed in yet
empty.body: Work your teacher reads shows up here — with what they said about it.
empty.filteredBody: Nothing of yours is in this state right now.

redo.banner: {teacher} sent this back for another go
redo.bannerUnsigned: This came back for another go

resubmit.label: Your second go
resubmit.placeholder: Write it again, with the comment above in mind.
resubmit.sent: Sent. It is with your teacher again.
resubmit.alreadyThere: It was already with your teacher — nothing was sent twice.

failed.not-sent: That did not go through. Your text is still here — try again.
failed.delivered: It reached your teacher after all. Nothing more to do.
failed.unconfirmed: Could not confirm whether it went through. Your text is kept — check "My work" before sending again.
